exploit_name: Incorrect TWAP calculation in BalancerPriceOracle allows price manipulation
description: The TWAP formula accumulates previous averages instead of actual prices. The code uses snapshot.averagePrice * elapsedTime instead of lastPrice * elapsedTime, creating recursive averaging and precision loss through integer division.
attack_scenario: Attacker manipulates pool after minUpdateTimePeriod, calls updatePrice() with corrupted average. Subsequent validations fail to detect the manipulation due to recursive averaging errors.
root_cause: The TWAP formula accumulates previous averages instead of actual prices. The code uses snapshot.averagePrice * elapsedTime instead of lastPrice * elapsedTime, creating recursive averaging and precision loss through integer division.
fix_description: Implement proper TWAP accumulation using observation buffers that store timestamped price snapshots and compute deltas correctly.
notes: The oracle becomes increasingly inaccurate over time. Attackers can exploit the compounding error to pass manipulated prices through validation.
